overview.projectName: SpotSense — Overhead Smart Parking Bay Occupancy Detector
overview.summary: SpotSense is an intelligent overhead parking sensor unit designed for multi-level garages. It continuously measures vehicle presence using ultrasonic sonar telemetry, signals slot availability with a high-intensity 360-degree RGB beacon, sounds proximity warnings, and displays bay status on an integrated OLED display.
overview.problemStatement: Drivers spend an average of 15 minutes searching for vacant spots in enclosed parking garages, producing excess emissions and traffic congestion due to lack of real-time slot occupancy sensing.
goals: Detect vehicle presence within 5cm to 350cm ceiling range in under 150ms
Drive visual green/red RGB beacon for driver guidance visible from 50 meters
Provide local I2C OLED display for bay ID, distance telemetry, and technician calibration
scope: WS2812B high-brightness RGB status indicator dome
ESP32 dual-core microcontroller with WiFi/BLE telemetry
0.96 inch I2C SSD1306 OLED bay status panel
12V DC input with onboard step-down buck converter
outOfScope: Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR) camera optical unit

hardware.workingPrinciple: Overhead ultrasonic transducer fires periodic sonic bursts towards the parking bay floor. When a vehicle occupies the slot, reflected pulse transit time drops significantly. The ESP32 parses distance thresholds, drives the WS2812B RGB light ring green/red, and outputs bay statistics over I2C to the OLED screen.

connections.purpose: Pulse duration return proportional to target distance
High-speed NRZ RGB color control stream

firmwareLogic.mainLoopDescription: Triggers ultrasonic sensor at 5Hz. Filters returned distance through a 5-point median filter. If distance is between 30cm and 220cm for >3 seconds, classifies bay as OCCUPIED (sets RGB to RED). Otherwise, classifies as VACANT (sets RGB to GREEN). Updates OLED display with bay ID, live distance, and occupancy icon.
setupSteps: Initialize GPIO5 as OUTPUT (Trig) and GPIO18 as INPUT (Echo)
Initialize FastLED / NeoPixel driver on GPIO19
Initialize I2C bus and SSD1306 OLED screen at 0x3C
safetyNotes: Use 5V-to-3.3V resistive divider on HC-SR04 Echo line to prevent overvoltage on ESP32 GPIO18
Ensure overhead ceiling mount is anchored securely above vehicular vibration zones

roadmap.title: Phase 1: Ultrasonic Calibration & Echo Filtering
roadmap.description: Interface HC-SR04 with ESP32 and calibrate distance thresholds for garage heights.
tasks: Implement 5-sample median filter to eliminate false spikes
Calibrate empty bay vs vehicle presence thresholds
completionCriteria: Stable distance telemetry output over serial stream

roadmap.title: Phase 2: RGB Visual Guidance & OLED Dashboard
roadmap.description: Integrate WS2812B NeoPixel ring color animations and SSD1306 bay status screen.
tasks: Program state machine for Vacant (Green), Occupied (Red), and Fault (Flashing Yellow)
Design OLED bay identifier and distance graphic layout
Connect piezo buzzer for over-height warning pulses
completionCriteria: Visual indicators reflect bay occupancy seamlessly in real time

roadmap.title: Phase 3: Ceiling Mount Enclosure & Garage Trial
roadmap.description: Mount into flame-retardant overhead casing with optical diffuser and run 48-hour garage test.
tasks: Assemble PCB, sonar transceiver, and RGB ring in ceiling-mount housing
Connect 12V garage power rail through step-down converter
completionCriteria: 100% occupancy detection accuracy across test parking cycles

assumptions.description: Ceiling height above parking slot is between 2.2m and 3.5m.
assumptions.reason: Within optimal HC-SR04 sonar detection cone and reflective gain.

openQuestions.question: Will the parking facility require ambient light level adaptation for daytime vs nighttime beacon brightness?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: May require an optional photoresistor (LDR) to dim LEDs at night.

risks.title: Sensor Drift During Initial Heating
risks.mitigation: Include software lockout requiring 24 hours of burn-in heating before saving baseline calibration.

risks.title: Sensor Poisoning from Aerosols
risks.mitigation: Clearly label enclosure warnings against using silicone adhesives, hairspray, or VOC cleaners near unit.

recommendations.title: LiPo Battery Backup with Charger IC
recommendations.description: Consider adding a single-cell LiPo battery and TP4056 charging IC for 2-hour backup during power outages.
